description: A lanky green troll with long sinewy limbs, shown nearly full figure, crouched and facing the viewer at eye level. Its skin is bright green with darker shading and touches of blue on the muscles, and its hands end in long hooked claws tipped with pale blue. Its head is small and knobbly with a gaping mouth showing sharp teeth. It is naked apart from its rough hide. The background is plain dark grey, keeping the focus on its hunched, menacing shape. Frame 1: the troll crouches, one claw hanging low and the other bent at its side. Frame 2: it swings one arm out to its side, the hand stretched long and blurred with speed. Frame 3: the arm is fully extended to the side, claws spread wide. Frame 4: the arm pulls back toward the body. Frame 5: it returns nearly to the crouch. The crouch is held long, the lunge holds briefly and the follow-through flashes by, so the loop reads as a wait, then a sudden raking swipe.
title: Troll lashing out with a claw
